 School Holidays 2026: Good News for Students.. Telangana & AP Schools to Remain Closed on These Days
 -->
 -->
 Sakshi Education 4 November 2026 -->
 Students and parents in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh can now plan ahead as schools will observe multiple holidays during November 2026. 
 The holidays include regular Sundays, festival holidays, and other scheduled breaks as per the respective school education department calendars. Students can check the complete November 2026 school holiday list to plan their academic activities accordingly.
November 2026 School Holidays List: Telangana & Andhra Pradesh
 Telangana School Holidays 2026 
 Schools across Telangana will observe holidays during November 2026 due to regular weekly offs and festival occasions.
 Telangana November Holiday Details: 
 November 8, 15, 22, and 29 – Sundays (School Holidays)
 Diwali Holiday – Schools will remain closed as per the official academic calendar
 Additional holidays may be announced based on local conditions or district-level decisions.
 Andhra Pradesh School Holidays 2026 
 Schools in Andhra Pradesh will also have holidays during November due to Sundays, festivals, and scheduled events.
 AP November Holiday Details: 
 November 5 – Schools may remain closed in view of the MPTC and ZPTC elections
 November 8, 15, 22, and 29 – Sundays (School Holidays)
 Diwali Holiday – As per the school academic calendar
 District-wise special holidays, if any, will be announced by the education department.
 Important Information for Students and Parents 
 Government and private schools must follow the instructions issued by the respective education departments regarding holidays. Students and parents are advised to confirm the final holiday schedule with their respective school managements or official announcements.
 Plan Studies During Holidays 
 Students, especially those preparing for upcoming examinations, can use the holiday period effectively by planning their study schedules in advance. Proper utilisation of holidays can help students revise lessons, complete assignments, and prepare better for exams.
